items.title: Android’s DIY widgets are a bit of vibe-coding fun
items.summary: Android users can now build personalized widgets using conversational AI tools, making rapid mobile micro-app development accessible to non-technical users.

items.title: Taking Trainium3 to the Track: Generating Videos with LTX-2.5
items.summary: Hugging Face demonstrated video generation using the LTX-2.5 model on Trainium3 chips, expanding hardware alternatives for compute-heavy generative media workflows.

items.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
items.summary: Nvidia halted server shipments to several Southeast Asian countries following tighter U.S. export controls, potentially disrupting regional AI infrastructure expansion.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue
items.summary: The massive commercial success of Grand Theft Auto VI highlights the enduring market value of heavily human-crafted products alongside the rise of enterprise AI.

items.title: Come for the Games, Stay for the Community With GeForce NOW
items.summary: Nvidia is spotlighting community engagement across its GeForce NOW cloud gaming platform, showing how streaming infrastructure supports broader digital social ecosystems.

items.title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
items.summary: Hugging Face launched a benchmark dashboard for running llama.cpp on AMD Ryzen and Radeon chips, helping builders evaluate local AI inference on AMD hardware.

items.title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
items.summary: Forty-two state attorneys general are moving to block Character.AI from selling private user chat logs during bankruptcy proceedings, signaling heightened regulatory scrutiny of AI data privacy.

items.title: Ars Live recap: Don’t expect military attacks on data centers to stop
items.summary: Military forces increasingly view cloud infrastructure and data centers as strategic wartime targets, raising physical resilience and redundancy concerns for digital businesses.

items.title: AI is straining America’s open records systems
items.summary: Automated public records requests powered by AI are overwhelming local government administrators, exposing operational bottlenecks in civic data transparency systems.

items.title: How Gemini is changing the game for Golden State's organization and fans.
items.summary: The Golden State sports organization partnered with Google Gemini to enhance fan experiences and enterprise operations, illustrating AI integration into live entertainment venues.

items.title: From spectrum to structure: Identifying molecules with Mass Spec Skills for Google Antigravity
items.summary: Google DeepMind released Mass Spec Skills on Google Antigravity to interpret tandem mass spectra, accelerating molecular identification for scientific and pharmaceutical research.

items.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
items.summary: OpenAI demonstrated that GPT-6 models can design functional protein structures and sequences, marking a significant step toward using general AI for biological engineering.
